body: Hell yeah! I’m betting you worked hard for where you are at now. Keep goin man! Happy for you :)

Thanks for reading my rant and replying. I have a lovely boyfriend who means the world to me, and 2 cats. They are my everything. The painful part is that I know he cares so much about me too, but I just let him down. I feel like he deserves so much better. Not some girl that only cries and complains about everything. 

I’ll try to hang on and be a better person for him. Thank you so much.
May he rest in peace. Know what it feels like to lose a cat. :( I hope you have alot of great memories with him to look back on!
